incoming_outgoing_vertex_regrouping.description: assemble each vertex as its outgoing edge antiderivative less its incoming edge antiderivative before the contour sum
incoming_outgoing_vertex_regrouping.verdict: numerically identical to paired endpoint differencing

canonical_vertex_gauge_subtraction.description: subtract the exact finite-section antiderivative of a canonical vertical incident edge from both endpoint values before edge and contour reduction
canonical_vertex_gauge_subtraction.verdict: numerically identical to paired endpoint differencing

interpretation.mechanism: paired-fp64 addition and subtraction already preserve both algebraically equivalent gauge placements, so changing only the contour assembly order cannot recover scalar-rounded primitive inputs
